name: theme-factory

summary.en: Anthropic’s skill for applying one of ten preset color-and-font themes, or a generated one, to slides, documents and web pages.
summary.zh: Anthropic 出品，为幻灯片、文档和网页套用十套预设配色字体主题之一，或现场生成新主题。

upstreamDescription: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.
